name: json-log-championship-roster-v1
status: frozen prospective roster; not yet executed
purpose: Freeze, before any execution, the complete championship comparison roster, tool identities, framing, gates, and decision reducer for a prospective JSON/log complete-byte championship. Execution is owner-gated and comes only after independent dedicated-machine reproduction of the JLS2 v2 public-validation pass.
claim_ceiling: Category-scoped public-validation product pass on the two named previously unopened CLUE-LDS temporal ranges. This roster does not, and its future execution may not, support universal, state-of-the-art, market-leading, world-best, or beats-all-compressors language. Tools that cannot be reproduced comparably are unavailable or contextual, never beaten.

extends.note: The framing, gates, instrument, and one-way-door discipline are inherited unchanged from the frozen JLS2 v2 public validation. This roster only extends the standard set with the research-tier Kanzi and ZPAQ tools and pins their identities.

order: freeze this roster (this document, no measurements)
independent dedicated-machine reproduction of the JLS2 v2 public-validation pass
owner dispatch of a championship execution on fresh sealed data
only after all of the above: private-holdout acquisition
sequencing.rule: This roster must be frozen BEFORE any private-holdout acquisition. Private-holdout identities never enter this repository by design.

framing.accounting_note: Every tool is scored on the complete archive bytes required to exactly restore the source, including any container, header, dictionary, pattern file, or framing wrapper. Same rule as JLS2 v2. For PBC the complete archive is the pattern file plus the compressed payload.
framing.timeout_rule: A tool that does not finish an item within the frozen per-item wall budget is recorded as a did-not-finish for that item and is not eligible for a championship comparison on it; it is never silently dropped.

runner_class.note: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-22.04, 4 vCPU, matching the JLS2 v1 and v2 evidence class.

memory_rules.rule: A tool is eligible for the product claim only when its worst cold-process standalone decode peak RSS is at most 512 MiB under the clean-child instrument. Research-tier tools that exceed the decode gate are reported as contextual, not eligible, and cannot be counted as beaten or as beating JLS2 for the product claim.

regression_rules.per_item: Every family (per temporal range) is scored individually; JLS2 must be the smallest eligible complete archive on each family.
regression_rules.note: Gains are measured against the smallest complete exact-byte result among every eligible available tool, not against a single named baseline.

speed_tiers.note: Speed tiers are inherited from the JLS2 v2 gates. Speed is reported for context on every tool; the championship decision is a ratio-and-eligibility decision, not a speed decision.

roster.config_rationale: Level 5 at a 16 MiB block (-method 54) is the strongest practical ZPAQ configuration that the frozen E2-A memory evidence shows stays within the 512 MiB decode gate: zpaq-5-m54 peaks at 343.3 MiB decode RSS and 358.3 MiB compress RSS (memory-eligible, runs/json-context-ceiling-e2-a-v1/). Larger blocks recover up to the full 21.32% ratio gap but exceed the gate on decode: zpaq-5-m57 (128 MiB block) and zpaq-5-m510 (1 GiB block) both measure 1272.1 MiB decode RSS. The 1 GiB-block config (-method 510) is carried as a separate contextual research-ceiling entry, never eligible under the product gates.

unavailable_or_contextual.reason: The official repository contains only LICENSE and README.md; no runnable source, release, or benchmark artifact is published. Absence is not an Axiom win.
The official GitHub repository is empty and exposes no commit, source, release, license, or benchmark artifact. Absence is not an Axiom win.

No top-level software license was found (do not vendor or patch); build blocked on Apple ARM64, an AVX-512 requirement, and case-colliding paths; pending a licensed x86-64 AVX-512 reproduction host. Absence is not an Axiom win.

No top-level software license was found (do not vendor or patch); Docker daemon unavailable, source build lacks libarchive headers, bundled binaries are Linux x86-64; pending license clarification and pinned container digests. Absence is not an Axiom win.

Official JSON documentation states timezone information and event order are not preserved, so it is ineligible for a byte-exact comparison; context-only semantic log compressor. Absence is not an Axiom win.

Level 5 at a 1 GiB block (-method 510) is ZPAQ's research-ceiling configuration. The frozen E2-A evidence measures its decode RSS at 1272.1 MiB, far over the 512 MiB product decode gate, so it is never eligible under the product gates. It is reported alongside as a contextual ratio ceiling; its results are contextual, never losses or wins. Same treatment as zstd --long=31.

kanzi_zpaq_rule: Kanzi and ZPAQ may not be quietly omitted from any championship claim. If either cannot run comparably on the frozen runner, the exact reason is documented and it is classified unavailable or contextual, never beaten. A championship claim that omits either without a documented reason is invalid.

decision_reducer.eligible_tool_definition: An available tool that produces a byte-exact roundtrip preserving record order and timezone text, finishes every item within the timeout, and whose worst cold-process standalone decode peak RSS is at most 512 MiB under the clean-child instrument.
decision_reducer.championship_candidate_requirement: JLS2 is a championship candidate only if, on fresh sealed data under these frozen gates, it produces the smallest complete exact-byte archive against EVERY eligible available tool on every family and in aggregate (at least 5% smaller than the strongest eligible complete exact-byte result per family and aggregate), while passing all exactness, determinism, corruption-rejection, accounting, memory, and speed gates.
decision_reducer.contextual_and_unavailable: Contextual tools (in-repo but over the decode gate or not byte-exact) and unavailable tools (no reproducible implementation) are reported alongside the decision but are never counted as beaten and never counted as beating JLS2 for the product claim.

no_measurements_note: This document freezes a prospective protocol only. It contains no measurements, downloads no new binaries, and makes no claim beyond the frozen JLS2 v2 claim ceiling.
